R82 R87 a venue's facts: fact of VENUE_FACTS (delivery_point among them), value ≤ 500, amount in R26's units, cited, sourced; one value per kind and fact

R86 phrasings: locale (isLocale), kind of PHRASING_KINDS, phrase of 2–100 characters on one line; a profile only adds; unioned
